name: Derby County Football Club
notes: Revenue and all P&L figures from the club's own accounts for the year to 30 June 2025, as published on dcfc.co.uk (the Companies House copy is a scan with no text layer). Revenue breakdown maps Ticketing to matchday, League and broadcasting to broadcast, Sponsorship to commercial and Other revenue to other; the accounts' separate 'Hospitality, events and catering' line (£6,697,031) fits none of the four slots and is left out, so the slots do not sum to turnover. Net debt is the accounts' note 16 total, almost all owed to Clowes Developments (£63,081,650 owed to the ultimate parent). Companies House PSC: The Clowes Trust 2014 controls Clowes Developments (75% or more). Chair: the club lists a board of David Clowes and Richard Tavernor without a chair title, so chair is left null. No valuation, social counts or stadium price found on citable pages. League: Derby stay in the Championship in 2026/27.

ownership_summary: Owned by Clowes Developments (UK) Limited, the Ashbourne property developer controlled by The Clowes Trust 2014 (David Clowes), which bought the club out of administration on 1 July 2022 and the stadium company separately. Since May 2025 club and stadium sit under Derby County (The Rams) Holdings Limited, 100% owned by Clowes Developments; a sale of a controlling interest to Turki Alalshikh's Lion Sport collapsed in August 2026 and the club was taken off the market.
